items.text:
The best LIFE to live is LOVE.
The best time to love is now.
Live your best life NOW!

It is possible to do GOOD
for BAD REASONS.
Should we be more concerned about been GOOD or been RIGHT?
What realities can we perceive and understand with accuracy and discernment?
What is THE TRUTH about past, recent and present realities?
